_about: Hero voice lines, keyed by the character's PrimaryClass. A character is a pairing (PrimaryClass/SecondaryClass) and NEUTRAL is not pairable, so there are exactly 8 voices. Stems follow vo_<class>_<moment>_<n> and resolve as sfx/<stem>, the same Addressables address the card sound player already uses.

_moments.match_start: No MatchStarted event exists in GameEventKind. The first TurnStarted is the only stand-in.
_moments.turn_start: Fires every turn. Three variants WILL grate over a 20-turn match -- play these at reduced probability, or widen to 6+ before shipping.
_moments.rope: Server fires at ServerOptions.RopeMs = 15_000, i.e. 15s before the deadline. TurnClockView already reacts to it by tinting the number red.
_moments.win: MatchOutcome.Player0Win / Player1Win, resolved against the local seat.
_moments.lose: Same event, opposite seat. MatchOutcome.Draw has no line and falls through silent.

EMBERWARD.why: Zeal, forges and vanguards. Young and rough, charges forward.

match_start: Light the forge. We burn today.
Let them come. I have fire enough.
rope: Decide! The fire will not wait.
win: The forge held. You did not.

TIDECALLER.why: Oracles, prophets and deep water. Cool, certain, unhurried.

match_start: I have seen how this ends.
Come in. The water is deep here.
rope: The tide does not wait for you.
win: As the water said it would be.
The tide keeps what it takes.

GRAVEKEEP.why: Bells, revenants and sealed gates. The growl carries the menace the class text implies.

match_start: The bell has rung for you.
turn_start: The dead are patient. I am not.
win: Down you go. Down you stay.
lose: So the gate opens for me.
I go to my own ground.

VERDANT.voice_name: Matthew Schmitz - Ancient Sage Dragon Wizard
VERDANT.why: Elders, ancients and world-roots. Old age and rasp is exactly the class's register.

match_start: You are standing on old roots.
rope: Even roots run out of season.

CLOCKWRIGHT.why: Blueprints and artificers. Clean and precise rather than warm.

NIGHTVEIL.why: Spies, veils and whisper queens. Deceptively gravelly with an unsettling edge.

turn_start: My move. You will not see it.
win: You never had a chance to look.
That is how it is done.

STONEWARDEN.why: PLACEHOLDER -- Sam has picked a gruff stoic voice for this class already. Swap the id.

win: The wall holds. It always holds.

TEMPEST.why: Bolt riders and gale heralds. The only class that should sound delighted to be here.

win: The storm passes. You do not.
